questionsToConsider: What's the minimum age in your area, and do you ask for ID at the appointment?
Which styles do your artists actually work in, so the options match your portfolio?
Do you take cover-ups, and does every artist do them?
Do you take a deposit, and how will you explain it when you reply?
guide.howToUseResponses: Pass each response to the artist the client asked for, or to whoever's style matches, with the references and any cover-up photos attached. The size, placement and colour answers let them estimate sessions and time before the consult, and the flexibility score tells them how much to push their own design. Read the health notes before booking and follow up on anything that needs a doctor's go-ahead. Clients who are just exploring can wait; those who want to start soon should hear back first.
customizeSteps: Edit the styles to match your artists, and add or remove placements you don't tattoo.
Change the age check if your local minimum differs, and rewrite the ending in your studio's voice.
Put the link in your social profile and on your website's booking page.

faqs.q: What should I bring to a tattoo consultation?
faqs.a: Reference images, a clear idea of placement and size, and photos of any tattoo you want covered. This form collects all of that in advance.

faqs.q: What does a tattoo consultation form ask?
faqs.a: The design idea, style, placement, size, colour, reference images, timing and any health information the artist needs to know.

faqs.q: How do I handle clients who are under 18?
faqs.a: Ask first. This form ends politely for anyone under 18, so they never fill in the rest and you never have to turn them down later.
Yes. They can attach up to five images, plus separate photos when it's a cover-up, and you'll see them with the response.

doc.title: Tattoo consultation
doc.description: Arrive at every tattoo consultation already knowing the idea, the spot and the references.

blocks.title: Hey! Tell us about the tattoo you have in mind.
Will this be your first tattoo?
Describe the idea in your own words
blocks.description: What it shows, what it means to you, anything it must include.

blocks.title: Which style is closest to what you want?
Where on your body would it go?

options.label: Small
options.description: About the size of a coin

options.label: Medium
options.description: About the size of a palm

blocks.title: Would this cover or rework an existing tattoo?
Please upload a clear photo of the tattoo you want covered
blocks.description: Good light, taken straight on, so the artist can see what they're working with.

blocks.title: Share any reference images
blocks.description: Art you like, other tattoos, photos. Artists use these for inspiration, not to copy.

blocks.title: How much creative freedom would you give the artist?
When would you like to get started?

options.label: In the next couple of months

blocks.title: Is there an artist here you'd like to work with?
blocks.description: Leave it blank and we'll match you with whoever suits the style.

blocks.title: Anything the artist should know about your skin or health?
blocks.description: Allergies, medication, skin conditions, or anything that makes sitting still hard.

blocks.title: How can the artist get back to you?

endings.title: Got it, thank you ✍️
